reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per paid channel and month with spend, 2024 and 2025
  SELECT ch.channel_name, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.channel_name, m.month, m.spend_eur, p.spend_eur AS spend_prev_year_eur
FROM monthly m
LEFT JOIN monthly p ON p.channel_name = m.channel_name AND p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR
WHERE m.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'

solver.query:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT ch.channel_name, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT cur.channel_name, cur.month, cur.spend_eur, prev.spend_eur AS spend_prev_year_eur
FROM monthly cur
LEFT JOIN monthly prev ON prev.channel_name = cur.channel_name AND prev.month = CAST(cur.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AS DATE)
WHERE cur.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
